data: What is the value of the validation loss for purple line at epoch 5, in right bottom plot?

The question asks for the value of the validation loss for the purple line at epoch 5 in the right bottom plot. The right bottom plot shows the model loss (validation). The purple line corresponds to Model 4. At epoch 5, the purple line intersects the y-axis around 0.5. Therefore, the value of the validation loss for the purple line at epoch 5 is approximately 0.5.
